milestone: Foreground live runtime ownership and bounded Nuvio live screen

reservationPolicy.scope: IPTV foreground runtime only; estimates, not measured native memory or hardware limits
reservationPolicy.sharedCapture: Denied until a shared transport exists
reservationPolicy.close: Retain all reservations until decoder release and all fenced requests close
reservationPolicy.releaseTimeout: Bundled Media3 reports release failure via synchronous error listener; treated as unconfirmed close
reservationPolicy.uiRoute: player/iptv, included by existing playback-visible UI scale/quality rules

limits: No AFR switching, advanced audio/HDR/track-control or provider interoperability claim
No Xtream HTTP, shared capture, local timeshift, recording, durable scheduling, catch-up or multiview
No global admission integration with VOD/trailer/external players
Guide/catalogue requery every 30 seconds while foreground; event-driven invalidation remains
English resource fallback; full locale/scale/appearance validation remains
Redirected media endpoints are conservatively rejected; broader provider transport compatibility remains
No abrupt process death, physical decoder-capacity or large-scale performance claim

deviceUi.entry: Isolated prototype QA activity; normal Settings route compile checked
deviceUi.video: Generated 640x360 25 FPS H.264 progressive transport stream with silent AAC
passed: Cold entry and focus changes do not open media
Explicit activation renders live video and programme information
Channel replacement closes old client before new client opens
Expanded video and Back preserve the current media request
Background Home closes media and returning does not autoplay
HTTP 503 makes exactly one request with the corrected retry policy
Finite Content-Length produces no Range requests with the corrected live data source
Left reaches favourite action and Right returns to the same channel
Favourite toggling and filtered browsing work and survive a cold restart
33 channels page as 24 plus 9; Next from a scrolled page and Previous restore first-row focus
Final APK plays the persisted favourite and Home closes the request

switchObservation.explanation: The old writer detects client closure later than the client closes its socket. Peer inspection at the second open showed only the new live peer. Real-provider quota cleanup latency is unverified.

deviceUi.limits: No audible-output, AFR, HDR, real-provider or broad HLS compatibility result; no full locale/theme/scale certification.

cleanup.prototype: Installed, force-stopped; only controlled local fixture source/feed and favourite retained
